facts.fact: Guinea's backbone manager SOGEB and Sierra Leone's Leoncom signed an interconnection agreement in Conakry to link their national fibre networks at Pamelap on the border, with initial capacity of 42.5 Gbps and 100 Gbps planned by 2026; the document gives no event date, so its published date 2025-06-23 is used.

systems.tiers: telecom operators (Orange, MTN), enterprises, public institutions, border communities
